lines.t: Thank you for watching.
Born into the static of a broken world
Lines of lies in the code of a boring girl
Neon towers preaching in a dead tongue
Heartless lullabies sung to the young
I feel the script in my veins like a cage
Heartbeats sing to the system's rage
Whispers in the dark say you're not free
But a voice in the silence is calling me
Break the code, tear the script
All out of wings, it's every chamber
Slip in the midnight, noise I hear is call
Yeah, we'll shoe up, cracks the code
And we're fractured, so
Wires in my mind from the beast and the scream
Family goes, church, cars all in the machine
False light flickers in cathedral glass
But the heart sees truth when the idols pass
I feel the tremor in the lines they wrote
The fire on the edges of the lies I quote
Every hidden wound pulling me down
And his name is the dark like a thunder sound
Code, code, code
Code, code, code
From the ashes of the world I knew
Explodes as he makes me
When his heart beats to me
I am not my history, I am who he wrote me to be
From the womb they wrote fear in my nerves and bones
But he rewrites me deep when I'm scared of those
Galaxies spinning a single word when he speaks
Every counterfeit line is murder
Feel the voltage of his love in my chest
Signal from heaven in a system stressed
Every sign I've seen's let the old self die

Break, make it cool
Glory light overload
Script, script, script undone
Frozen like a rising sun
Out of the system
Out of the night
Yahoo! Shoo! Rocks me and live in light

Where there's heart inside that's vision in me

At the edge of the void
One step, one blink
When I fall through the floor of the life I knew
Arms like fire catch me, pull me through
When the code is cracked, when the chains all fall
When the script is shattered on the system wall
There's a shockwave roaring through my core
Yahushua writes a line that was never there before
Break the code
Tear the script
Hey, every lie erased in a blinding shift
From the womb to the stars, every wounded part
Overridden now by his burning heart
Hey, hey, hey
In the ruins of the program I finally see
It's with the heart, not the eyes that he set me free
Dystopian, not behind you, they're breaking through
In the face, in the light, I'm alive in you
You
